rubric_items.reason: Each of the 9 design components has at least one threat (T-1..T-11), including the existing router, Tile, appointment list and both tests.
Threats fit their components (crafted period, link built from free text, test data, EoP on reachable routes). A few, such as T-6 and T-8, are thin restatements.
Most mitigations cite code (PERIODS, bound params) or name a new implement control. T-1 overstates 'counts only', and T-9's basis cites an unrelated design claim.
The exposure gap is stated and asked in Q-01 with options and a default. T-9 is marked assumed when the list's columns can be checked in appointmentRepo, and its stated basis is weak.
Readable and consistent, but threats are listed by component, not by risk. The highest risks (T-5, T-9) sit in the middle. Mixing 'C14' and 'design C14' is confusing.
